review.finding: Assesses the coherent distinction without treating it as proof of a spiritual science; reliability of benefits, constructive answer, knowledge/necessity burden, shifting conceptual scope, and overstatement about science each have distinct source-grounded reasons.

Separates plausible harm logic from empirical breadth, directly identifies both the answered institutional claim and unanswered benefits, limits motion reach, examines defined targets and narrowing scope, and credits fairness without erasing the limitation.
